title: Quick check: Installing and Configuring Node.js

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Installing and Configuring Node.js”?
options: The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
Node.js and npm should be justified by requirements, acceptance criteria, tests, and explicit trade-offs.
The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
questions.answer_key: Node.js and npm should be justified by requirements, acceptance criteria, tests, and explicit trade-offs.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Installing and Configuring Node.js: Node.js and npm should be justified by requirements, acceptance criteria, tests, and explicit trade-offs.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying Node.js and npm?
options: Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Document what is in scope, what is out of scope, and how reviewers can reproduce the result.
Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
questions.answer_key: Document what is in scope, what is out of scope, and how reviewers can reproduce the result.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Installing and Configuring Node.js: Document what is in scope, what is out of scope, and how reviewers can reproduce the result.

questions.prompt: What should you verify before considering “Installing and Configuring Node.js” complete?
options: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
Check only whether the file exists; syntax and runtime behavior do not matter.
Assume a client-side check proves that a remote service accepted the change.
Rely only on a screenshot of the happy path and never repeat the test.
questions.answer_key: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Installing and Configuring Node.js: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
